# Remote Package Installer NG v0.0.1

The first public release of a free desktop app that installs PS4 game files (`.pkg`) over your home network — no USB stick, no FTP.

## What you need

- A PS4 with [GoldHEN](https://github.com/GoldHEN/GoldHEN) (use its **Package Installer**), or [RPI NextGen](https://github.com/AldySan/ps4_remote_pkg_installer_nextgen)
- Your PS4 and your computer on the same network
- Your own `.pkg` files

## Downloads

Pick the file for your computer:

- **Windows** — `RemotePackageInstallerNG-v0.0.1-Windows-x64.zip`
- **Mac** — `RemotePackageInstallerNG-v0.0.1-macos-universal.tar.gz` (works on every Mac)
- **Linux** — `RemotePackageInstallerNG-v0.0.1-Linux-x64.tar.gz`

First-run notes:

- **Windows** may show "Windows protected your PC" — click *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
- **macOS** may say the app "cannot be verified" — right-click it, choose *Open*, then *Open* again.

## How to use it

Short version: open the Package Installer on your PS4, run this app on your computer, add your `.pkg` files, press Start. Full guide in the [README](https://github.com/AldySan/Remote-Package-Installer-NG#how-to-use).

Found a problem? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/AldySan/Remote-Package-Installer-NG/issues) — this is an early release and reports help a lot.
